method: Independent ground truth was saved before inspecting model outputs. Every source page and every exported 300-DPI PNG was visually reviewed; each resource was matched by its actual source diagram/table content, caption, number and page, not by counts alone. All 17 CSV files and HTML table grids were read and checked against resource-auto.json. The 30 predefined sample cells were checked at their semantic row/column, with model/header labels verified. Additional visible structure defects were recorded separately from predefined samples.
crop_policy: Complete means the diagram/table body, labels, legends, subpanels and values are visible. Captions are stored separately and are not required to be baked into the crop PNG. Exact line-thickness clipping at a tight detection boundary is not scored as missing scientific content.
limits: This is a human review of three selected openly licensed papers, not a representative accuracy estimate. The 30 predefined cells are a small sample from three tables; their success cannot establish correctness of all 17 tables. Export consistency checks establish serialization consistency only, not source fidelity. Unnumbered code examples are outside the numbered Figure/Table ground truth but were inspected for erroneous extra detections.

papers.scope: Whole publisher PDF, physical pages 1-16, printed pages 4171-4186. Includes all of Appendices A-C beginning on physical page 12 (index 11), including Figures 3-5 and Table 8. External supplementary files are outside scope.

objects.caption_reference: Figure 3: Differences in pre-training model architectures.
objects.actual_caption: Figure 3: Differences in pre-training model architectures. BERT uses a bidirectional Transformer. OpenAI GPT uses a left-to-right Transformer. ELMo uses the concatenation of independently trained left-to-right and right-toleft LSTMs to generate features for downstream tasks. Among the three, only BERT representations are jointly conditioned on both left and right context in all layers. In addition to the architecture differences, BERT and OpenAI GPT are fine-tuning approaches, while ELMo is a feature-based approach.

issues.description: Source has 22 logical rows: one header, three section headings and 18 distinct model-score rows. Export has seven rows; multiple models and scores are concatenated inside cells, section text is split between model and score cells, and sections are reordered. BERT-NLI-STSb-large appears in export row 5 with the STS-only model block, while its 88.77 ± 0.46 score appears in row 6 alongside the two SBERT/SRoBERTa labels. Full table PNG is complete, but the machine-readable model-score associations are unreliable.
